# Pending lines of the spec-program targets (programs_fuzz_test.go).
#
# Forms of SKILL.md's table that the generator does not write, and why
# (TestGeneratorMatchesSpecForms reads these):
#
# Compiler gaps the generator found. A pending feature stays out of
# campaigns. Each gap is pending under its oracle's key, which names what
# disagreed and the feature it needs (<oracle>:<what>/<feature>, see specGaps
# in programs_fuzz_test.go), so a new disagreement of an input that holds the
# feature still fails. The corpus line only marks the reproduction, which
# holds every feature and fails as XPASS once every oracle holds.
# Retired 2026-10-29: the VIPs replaced the language these targets generate.
FuzzSpecPrograms  *  superseded  VIP-31: VibeLang has no runtime semantics of its own, and nothing of old VibeLang is part of the language unless a VIP adds it; FuzzVIPDifferential checks programs against each VIP's Effect TS, so this generator of the old language is retired
FuzzSpecVariants  *  superseded  VIP-31: VibeLang has no runtime semantics of its own, and nothing of old VibeLang is part of the language unless a VIP adds it; FuzzVIPDifferential checks programs against each VIP's Effect TS, so this generator of the old language is retired

# Additional code spans in the Forms table that the generator does not write.

#
# s3 (D382, D394, D433): an await operation's operand is a program by syntax, and a
# site whose meaning changed from VibeLang 0.0.10 is EK1023. The generator writes
# await.all's do-block elements and records with 0.0.10's evaluation order.
